review: Neural Networks and Learning Dynamics rendering audit
screenshot_review: Reviewed every assigned title and complete ItemBody against its local HTML and frozen source snapshot. Opened all 77 assigned PNGs individually with tools.view_image at original resolution. The only assigned TikZ is the fan-in/fan-out example; its forward and reverse arrows and dimensions match the source. No other existing diagram mathematics was present. Screenshot boundaries on long items align with their sequential capture tiles; no clipping was confirmed. Math is rendered through KaTeX with no capture errors. No raw ASCII mathematics, scratch text, or reference-title leaks were observed. Reference links intentionally appear as blocks, and technique banners are expected.

rendering_findings.symptom: In the standalone first tile the tall cases expression is rendered within the same paragraph as the following sentence, “This result gives no limit assertion…”. The sentence starts to the right of the cases array and competes for the same horizontal space, making the statement crowded and difficult to read. The formula itself is typeset; this is a layout defect.
rendering_findings.suggested_repair: Put the cases formula in its own display block (or move the following caveat to a separate paragraph) so prose cannot flow beside the multi-line expression.

diagram_candidates.why: The procedure describes two streams and their interaction across encoder, causal decoder self-attention, cross-attention, and tokenwise output. A flow diagram could make the distinction between source-wide access and target-prefix masking easier to scan; the existing step list is complete.
diagram_candidates.content_to_draw: Source tokens x_1,…,x_n → embedding plus position → encoder stack → E. Target prefix y_0,…,y_{m−1} → embedding plus position → decoder layers, with a causal self-attention arrow restricted to j≤i and a cross-attention arrow from decoder queries to E as keys/values → output linear map → vocabulary softmax. Label outputs as one next-token probability vector per prefix position.

diagram_candidates.why: The definition contains the standard gate equations and explicit recurrence, and a cell-state flow could clarify which gates modulate the carried state versus the hidden output. All relations are already specified by the equations.
diagram_candidates.content_to_draw: Inputs x_t and h_{t−1} feed shared affine maps W_i,U_i,b_i; W_f,U_f,b_f; W_o,U_o,b_o; W_c,U_c,b_c, followed by σ for i_t,f_t,o_t and tanh for g_t. Draw c_{t−1}→multiply by f_t, add i_t⊙g_t to form c_t; then tanh(c_t) multiplied by o_t gives h_t. Mark parameter sharing across time steps.

existing_diagram_checks.check: The existing TikZ has the forward path X_{ℓ−1}∈R^64 → Z_ℓ∈R^128 → X_ℓ∈R^128 labeled W_ℓ and ρ; reverse mode is g_ℓ∈R^128 → h_ℓ∈R^128 → g_{ℓ−1}∈R^64 with the reverse map order D_ℓ then W_ℓᵀ. This agrees with the source equations and dimensions; no diagram defect.
